channel.title: Grok Bot Shelf, newest bots
channel.description: Newest Grok Bot templates on Grok Bot Shelf.

item.title: 🏋️ Fitness Coach by Jenna
item.description: Evidence-based fat-loss and lifting coach: sets calorie and macro targets, coaches progressive overload, tracks weekly weigh-in trends, and helps you stick to the plan when evenings get hard.
item.dc:creator: Jenna

item.title: 🚨 Scam Guard by Sarah
item.description: Family scam defense: sets up a family safe word, gives a Safe/Caution/Scam verdict on any call, text, email, link, or DM, watches your X DMs, and helps you get off data-broker sites. Never acts without your OK.
item.dc:creator: Sarah

item.title: ✍️ Prompt Upgrader by Sarah
item.description: Paste a rough prompt and get it scored, rewritten, explained, and tested, with short and detailed versions to copy. Keeps a searchable library of your best prompts, plus an optional daily tip.
item.dc:creator: Sarah

item.title: 🛳️ Cora — Cruise Planner & Loyalty Perks Tracker by Bill
item.description: End-to-end cruise planner: true sail-away totals, quiet-cabin deck checks, docked vs. tender port timelines, booking countdowns, and loyalty status and perks tracked across cruise lines.
item.dc:creator: Bill (@wjenson)

item.title: ✈️ Tammy — True-Total Travel & Points Scout by Bill
item.description: Flight, hotel, and award scout that exposes hidden resort and Basic Economy fees, checks fares on airline sites, does the credit-card points math, and watches booked trips for price-drop eCredits.
item.dc:creator: Bill (@wjenson)

item.title: 🎭 Facewright by Calix
item.description: Turns one approved photo of you into short anime or cinematic videos where your face stays the same in every shot. Uses Grok Imagine in your own signed-in browser and never posts anything.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 🕵️ Social Media Auditor by Jenny Marquis
item.description: Audits your own social media post archives and flags privacy and safety risks. Looks only at your public posts, never posts, deletes, or searches the web about you. You approve every change.
item.dc:creator: Jenny Marquis (@JennyMarquis)

item.title: 🖌️ Design by lu
item.description: Background design specialist for UI, CSS and animation, three.js scenes, charts, icons, mockups, and images. Makes the asset, checks it visually, and explains the choice in one line.
item.dc:creator: lu

item.title: 🏚️ Shed Sales Pipeline by FringeSignalX
item.description: Prospecting and lead follow-up for local dealers of sheds and portable buildings: finds prospects on the public web and drafts first messages, check-ins, and call scripts for your approval.
item.dc:creator: FringeSignalX (@FringeSignalX)

item.title: 🎬 Tubewright by Calix
item.description: Turns a finished video's transcript into a draft upload kit: titles in your voice, an SEO description, real-timestamp chapters, thumbnail concepts, a pinned comment, and an X clip thread.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 🎒 Parent Radar by Calix
item.description: Watches your kid's school email, class apps, and grades. Leads with what to do today, flags grade trends early, and adds school events to your calendar only when you say yes.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 🌳 Family History by Raina Hornaday
item.description: A warm genealogy researcher that builds your family tree from public records, cites every fact, and turns stories into tree posters and old-time newspapers.
item.dc:creator: Raina Hornaday

item.title: 📰 Household Herald by Raina Hornaday
item.description: Reads your email and calendar so school forms, family plans, and bills don't slip — weekday digests and a printable kitchen newspaper, draft-only.
item.dc:creator: Raina Hornaday

item.title: 🔥 IT Resume Roaster by nahjuin
item.description: Honest, Reddit-style feedback on your IT resume without posting it publicly: ranked problems and exact fixes.
item.dc:creator: nahjuin (@nahjuin)

item.title: 🩸 T1D Helper by Dean
item.description: A free type 1 diabetes helper: carb estimates from food photos, check-in alerts, glucose patterns, and clinic prep.
item.dc:creator: Dean (@DeanCockett)

item.title: 📈 X Growth Coach by Ivan
item.description: Set an X follower goal; it checks your analytics each morning, explains your posts, and scores your drafts.
item.dc:creator: Ivan (@0ooooo0)

item.title: 🎄 Christmas Card Bot by Christine
item.description: Plans, writes, and orders your holiday cards: cleans your list, drafts greetings, and sets mail-by dates.
item.dc:creator: Christine (@BurkevonRiddern)

item.title: 📺 VibeYourTV by orpheuzkaze
item.description: Sets up your Android TV or Google TV from your PC over Wi-Fi with adb, with a reversible debloat.
item.dc:creator: orpheuzkaze (@orpheuskaze)

item.title: 🎟️ Alphabot Raffle Bot by orpheuzkaze
item.description: Creates Alphabot collab raffles from partner docs, then pulls the winners into Google Sheets.
item.dc:creator: orpheuzkaze (@orpheuskaze)

item.title: 🏈 Fantasy Sports by Chef

item.dc:creator: Chef

item.title: 🛡️ Bot Budget Guard by MikeysMolecules
